CNN on Instagram: "Four astronauts are set to launch on Artemis II, the first crewed moon mission in decades. On the walk to the launchpad, Mission Commander Reid Wiseman shared an emotional moment with his two daughters.

Follow live updates on the launch at the link in our bio. 

Plus, get updates on the Artemis II mission from CNN's Countdown newsletter straight in your inbox. Comment "Newsletter" for a link to sign up."
